stem.text: Bromoethane reacts with cyanide ions, producing propanenitrile.
Which statement about the $\text{S}_\text{N}2$ mechanism of this reaction is correct?

A.text: The lone pair of electrons on C of $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the carbon atom of the C–Br bond.

B.text: The lone pair of electrons on C of $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the carbocation formed when the C–Br bond breaks.

C.text: The lone pair of electrons on N of $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the carbon atom of the C–Br bond.

D.text: The lone pair of electrons on N of $\text{CN}^{-}$ attacks the carbocation formed when the C–Br bond breaks.
